name: Pace Calculator
description: Enter any two of distance, time and pace and get the third, with splits, speed and predicted times for 5K to marathon.
prompt: A running pace calculator in km or miles: fill in two of distance, time and pace and it solves the third, with race presets, speed, a splits table and race time predictions using Riegel's formula.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Pon dos de distancia, tiempo y ritmo y te da el tercero, con parciales, velocidad y tiempos previstos de 5K a maratón.
